'''November 2001 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Junior's Cards and Comics, Austin, Texas on 3 November 2001. It is known from Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3094">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-05-austin-texas-11-03-01-non-flipping-wysd3094/ austin-texas-11-03-01-non-flipping-wys], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 5 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-05-austin-texas-11-03-01-non-flipping-wysd3094/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Junior's Cards and Comics, Austin, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]<ref name="tr-d3096" />
